apps.localizedDescription: An on-device debugger and JIT enabler for iOS 17.4 and newer, powered by idevice.

versions.localizedDescription:
Transitions to mounting the DDI via cryptex, should fix issues with the iPhone 18 Pro series. Also, now the DDI only unmounts after an update/reset, no more reboots!

## What's Changed
* Add Malloc Debugging by @Leviidev in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/460

## New Contributors
* @Leviidev made their first contribution in https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/pull/460

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug/compare/3.1.10...3.1.11
